notes: Tasks are ordered by priority (ascending = do first). Pick the lowest-priority task where passes is false and its deps (by id) all have passes:true. credential_gated tasks need real secrets to fully verify live; implement + mock-test them per the 'Notes for the autonomous build loop' section in PLAN.md, and mark passes true only once the mocked test suite is green.
